dedupe_keys.name: gcca in numbers gnr 2 0 global cement industry co2 and energy database

description: The GNR ('GCCA in NumbeRs'), formerly the Cement Sustainability Initiative database and run by the Global Cement and Concrete Association since 2018, collects plant data from cement producers under the GCCA Cement CO2 and Energy Management Protocol and publishes aggregated indicators by region and country. Coverage: GCCA members, who account for the majority of global cement volume outside China; data for 1990, 2000 and 2005 to 2024, collected each June and July with a two-year non-disclosure lag; parameters include clinker, cement and cementitious production by kiln type, gross and net CO2 emissions as totals, weighted averages and distributions, carbon intensity of the fuel mix, plant and external power consumption, thermal energy and fuel mix including alternative fuels and biomass; regions and countries are shown only where anti-trust and confidentiality rules allow. Format and access: an online report ('GNR2.0_global') reached after registration and acceptance of a Terms of Use contract, refreshed six times a day; non-members see the General, Production, MIC, CO2, Thermal Energy and Power tabs, members see all tabs. Licence: the Terms of Use contract was not read; no fee is mentioned on the pages read. Caveats: aggregated indicators only, no plant-level data; coverage excludes most Chinese producers; the protocol changes from version 3.1 to 4.2 in September 2027. Simulation uses: production, energy and emission baselines for the cement supply chain in capacity planning and climate adaptation studies of construction materials. Related records: the US life cycle inventory database (data-us-life-cycle-inventory-database-uslci).
